description: This file defines the SparkSaslServer class, which manages the state of a SASL authentication session in Spark, specifically implementing the DIGEST-MD5 mechanism with support for encryption options. It includes callback handling for authentication and methods for wrapping/unwrapping data.

classes.name: SparkSaslServer
classes.description: Manages a SASL session for Spark, handling authentication state, response evaluation, and data wrapping/unwrapping.

methods.name: isComplete
methods.description: Checks if the SASL authentication process has completed successfully.

methods.name: getNegotiatedProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a negotiated property from the SASL server.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Processes a SASL token and returns the response to be sent back.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the SASL server.
